site_name: Gumley House Convent School For Girls
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.
Condition : 3 - A schedule for all new windows, arches, doors and architrave (and any repair works to existing) at scale 1:20 shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority within two calendar months of the commencement of works and the approved details shall then be implemented and maintained thereafter.
Condition : 4 - A method statement for making good all eternal walls exposed after demolition shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority within two calendar months of the commencement of works and the approved details shall then be implemented and maintained thereafter.
Condition : 5 - Full details of the following at scale 1:20 or as appropriate shall be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority within two calendar months of the commencement of works and the approved details shall then be implemented and maintained thereafter.
new entrance structure to the north east wing
a) canopy over proposed entrance to convent
b) access ramp and handrail to steps
c) works to rainwater goods
description: Demolition of sanitary block incorporating new fenestration to exposed elevations. (Listed Building Works)
